For each entry it measures the multibyte length with WideCharToMultiByte, allocates a buffer via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc, converts the string into that buffer, and hands it to sub_598323. Returns 0 when the list is empty or fully processed; returns -1 when measurement, allocation, or conversion fails.
